tutors.question: What kind of tutors does ClassroomHub look for?
tutors.answer: We are looking for all kinds of tutors. The most important thing is that you have some experience teaching and a proven track record of excellent communication.

equipment.question: What equipment do I need to teach on ClassroomHub?
equipment.answer: You just need internet access and a laptop.

apply.question: What happens after I apply?
apply.answer: We will get your application and review it. You should get a response from us within 2-5 working days depending on the volume of applications.

earn.question: How much can I earn?
earn.answer: That depends on how much your course sells for and how many students buy it. Your income is limitless — you can keep making money while you sleep.

mcp.meta_title: MCP recipes for ClassroomHub | Build courses with your agent
mcp.meta_description: Ready-to-run prompts for the ClassroomHub MCP server. Generate courses, refresh content from updated docs, tag launches, and more — from Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.
mcp.heading_accent: keep your courses up to date.
mcp.subhead: Plug the ClassroomHub MCP server into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode. Then paste one of these prompts. The agent plans the work, waits for your approval, and runs it.
mcp.list_heading: Paste a prompt. Get the result.

author.title: Generate a customer onboarding course from a doc URL
author.description: The agent plans the course, drafts every lesson, and writes the quiz questions, then waits for your approval before publishing.

refresh.title: Refresh a compliance course after a policy update
refresh.description: When the policy changes, the agent identifies the affected lessons and drafts the revisions for your review.

launch.title: Tag every course tied to a new product launch
launch.description: Bulk-tag drafts and published courses so you can filter, assign, or report on them in one query.

quiz.title: Add quiz questions to an existing lesson
quiz.description: The agent reads the lesson body and generates assessment questions you can review before publishing.

reorder.title: Reorder lessons inside a course
reorder.description: Tell the agent what order matters; it reorders sections and lessons without touching the content.

audit.title: Audit every draft before publish
audit.description: Get a written summary of what each draft is missing: landing page, quiz questions, certificate rule, or final exam.
